series.label: SHPho-CB
series.notes: Panel (a) only (top-left panel of this multi-panel figure). Curve isolated by red RGB color mask (square markers, red dotted connecting line); marker centers found as connected-component centroids of red-colored pixels. Axis calibrated from the plot frame border pixels (x=0 at px147.5, x=30 at px984.5; y=0 at px673.5, y=120 at px43.5), cross-checked against the pixel positions of the printed tick-label glyphs (0,5,10,...,30 and 0,20,...,120), which matched the frame-based calibration within ~1 px. No embedded vector paths were present for this panel (flat raster image).

series.label: SHPho-Wenzel
series.notes: Panel (a) only. Curve isolated by blue RGB color mask (circular markers, blue dotted connecting line); markers are well separated with no overlap from other curves, giving a clean detection. Same axis calibration as the SHPho-CB series. A blue arrow near the top of this curve points to panel (b), not a data point, and was excluded (it forms a much larger, wider connected component than the circular markers and was filtered out).

series.label: Hydrophilic
series.notes: Panel (a) only, the bare-copper reference surface. Curve isolated by green RGB color mask (diamond markers, green dotted connecting line). Near x≈19.5°C the curve rises almost vertically through three closely-spaced diamond markers; these were still individually resolved as separate connected components and ordered by increasing heat flux to follow the curve. A green arrow near the top of the curve (pointing to panel (b)) was excluded as it forms a much larger connected component than the diamond markers. Same axis calibration as the other two series.

series.label: Zuber [1]
series.notes: Horizontal black reference line (Zuber critical-heat-flux correlation, annotated 'Zuber [1]' with a leader line), not one of the three tested surfaces, but included since it is a distinguishable, clearly labeled series spanning the full plot width at a constant heat flux (~110 W/cm2). Row position measured directly from the solid black horizontal line's pixel rows.
